briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ +0.9% and S&P 500 +0.3%. Cash reserve ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we held rather than forcing a buy on a low-conviction day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Holding cash when there's no strong signal is itself a valid investment decision, not inaction. Deploying capital just to feel productive on a neutral day often leads to weaker entries than waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with multiple confirming signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 在沒有明確訊號時持有現金本身就是一個合理的投資決定，並非什麼都不做。單純為咗「有所作為」而喺中性市況下勉強買入，通常會令入市價位遜色，倒不如耐心等待真正嘅風險偏好訊號同多重指標確認。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ outperforming the S&P 500, consistent with a mild risk-on tilt toward growth and tech names. Trading was largely directionless without a strong catalyst pushing volume or volatility to extremes. Existing positions were left to run since none hit stop-loss or profit-target thresholds.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納指升幅（+0.9%）跑贏標普500指數（+0.3%），反映市場對科技及成長股略為偏好風險。整體交投缺乏明顯催化劑，方向不算明確。現有持倉維持不動，因為未觸及止蝕或獲利了結水平。
